anomalies.description: A man in a blue shirt raises his arm and walks toward a line of police officers in riot gear; officers respond by advancing, raising shields, and drawing batons or less-lethal weapons (e.g., one officer points a weapon at ~41.0s). The interaction escalates from confrontation to active deployment of force by police against an individual, occurring within a context of collective tension and crowd presence, satisfying the definition of riot as violent unrest involving group dynamics and use of force.
